profiles.Summary: Blade & Sorcery is a VR-only title that requires a VR headset and SteamVR to function, making it fundamentally incompatible with the Steam Deck as a standalone handheld device. While Proton may allow the game to launch, without a connected PC VR headset the game cannot be played in any meaningful way on the Deck.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck player reports exist for this title; profiles are estimated from store requirements and hardware specs. Critically, Blade & Sorcery is flagged VR Only with no non-VR mode — on your first launch, confirm whether SteamVR even initialises without a headset, but expect the game to be unplayable as a handheld experience regardless of settings.
